results.label: the day is the server’s UTC day of the receipt
a late-evening intention is recorded for that day
the next UTC day starts with no intention, not yesterday’s
yesterday’s words are reported as history only, never as today’s
the show-history pointer grants nothing and carries no permission field
choosing the same words on the new day is a new day-scoped record, not a carry-over
the new day’s record keeps its own later receipt
the earlier day still reads exactly what was recorded then, readonly
a day with no record stays genuinely unrecorded
a day that has not happened is refused, never rendered as blank history

results.label: every recorded row is pinned to a real UTC day with its own version series
the human rows are never given a receipt outside their own day
a corrupt/future receipt marks the day unavailable rather than claiming a record
removing the corrupt row restores the honest record of that day
read-only views never wrote another revision
with no rows at all the day is unrecorded, not failed or unavailable
